title: My first attempt
author: AtomicMage
selftext:
A Flag guessing game I made using Opus 5.5 in the godot engine. I slowly added features and tweaks to make sure it did not get out of hand. I think it turned out really good. What is your thoughts?

[https://atomicmage.itch.io/flag-guesser](https://atomicmage.itch.io/flag-guesser)

https://i.redd.it/cleilrn2pczh1.png

replies.author: AtomicMage
replies.body: What do you mean? Make a bigger game? In that case Yes I am just trying to decide on the ideas I have. This was just to try out quickly I made it very quickly to test the godot strength and the agent

comments.author: NSTStudios
comments.body: Looks like a neat little project to start out. Any lessons learnt or new things discovered that you will keep in mind for the next project?

replies.author: AtomicMage
replies.body: Yes I will make the basic setups with menu and settings for time saving and also to have the ai build up tools for the engine and making tilesets, singletons etc..
